name: Meeting Outcomes Orchestrator
tagline: Turn every meeting into structured action items, research, emails, and calendar events — automatically.
description: An intelligent post-meeting agent that analyzes your task and automatically produces the right outputs. It extracts structured action items with owners and deadlines, drafts personalized follow-up emails using attendee names, conducts multi-source research with web search and Wikipedia, generates slide outlines with HTML previews, creates one-click Google Calendar links, and produces project plans or technical documentation. Unlike simple prompt-based agents, it uses an intelligent router to determine what you actually need and orchestrates specialized tools in parallel. No API keys required for core features.
